local _0x03057ad5 = bit32 and bit32.bxor or function(a, b)
    local r, p = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
        local ra, rb = a % 2, b % 2
        if ra ~= rb then r = r + p end
        a, b, p = (a - ra) / 2, (b - rb) / 2, p * 2
    end
    return r
end
